'''Kō Shrine''' ({{lang|ja|国府神社}})

* [[Kō Shrine (Takatori)]] - Located in {{ill|Takatori, Nara|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takatori, Nara}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|en|Nara Prefecture|qid=Q131287|lt=Nara Prefecture|1=Nara Prefecture}}. This shrine, situated in Shitakusa, Takatori, is the {{ill|Sōja|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sōja}} (provincial shrine) of {{ill|Yamato Province|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Province}}. It holds a distinguished position along with {{ill|Ōmiwa Shrine|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmiwa Shrine}}, being a central focus of faith and worship within the province.
* [[Kō Shrine (Ichikawa)]] - Found in {{ill|Ichikawa, Chiba|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ichikawa, Chiba}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chiba Prefecture}}, this ancient shrine was founded on February 8, 1087 (Eihō 7). Also known as Ōtori Ōkami, it enshrines {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Takeru}} as its deity.
